chunks: The Shaykh, the jurist, Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. 'Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd b. 'Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Al-Haytham b. Abi Masruq al-Nahdi narrated to us, from al-Hasan b. Mahbub, from Dawud b. Kathir al-Raqqi. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon him) said:

Whoever attends the funeral of a believer until he is buried in his grave, Allah the Mighty and Majestic will assign seventy-thousand angels from among the attendants to attend his funeral and seek forgiveness for him when he comes out of his grave.

key_terms.جَنَازَةَ: Funeral/funeral procession of a deceased person
key_terms.مَلَكٍ: Angel, celestial being assigned by Allah
key_terms.مُؤْمِنٍ: A believer, one with true faith
key_terms.يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ: They seek forgiveness (from Allah) on behalf of another

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for attending the funeral of a believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq teaches that attending a believer's funeral procession until burial earns the attendee a divine reward: seventy thousand angels will be assigned to escort and intercede for them on the Day they rise from their own grave. This teaching was shared to encourage believers to honor their deceased fellow Muslims by accompanying their funeral rites to completion, reflecting the importance of communal solidarity in death as in life.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Al-Haytham b. Abi Masruq al-Nahdi narrated to us from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from Dawud b. Kathir al-Raqqi.  He said: Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said:
Whoever attends the funeral of a believer until he is buried in his grave, Allah will assign seventy-thousand angels to attend his funeral and seek repentance for him when he comes out of his grave.
